name: Lapel
long_description:
Lapel is bringing hospitality to the internet.

Great service means knowing your customers and making every interaction count. Online, that gets harder as a company grows. Customer context is scattered across systems, leaving teams to piece it together.

Lapel unifies that data into a real-time picture of every account and helps teams turn what they know into coordinated action across the customer journey. The result is faster decisions, more proactive service, and interactions that feel personal at scale. We call it hospitality at scale.

Learn more at lapel.com.
one_liner: Infrastructure to power every customer interaction.
